CustomField.label: Active
CustomField.description: When checked, this Check Set is live. When unchecked, the entire Check Set is disabled without deleting metadata - no checks load or run, and the component shows a "Health Check Unavailable" message.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked = the Check Set is live. Uncheck to disable the whole set without deleting it (users see "Health Check Unavailable").
